# Waqar Ahmed — Spreadsheet & Data Specialist

> Waqar Ahmed is a self-employed spreadsheet and data specialist with 7 years of experience (MS Computer Science, University of Sindh, 2017), based in Karachi, Pakistan. He works written-only (email and messages, no calls) for clients worldwide. Every service below has a published work sample with its verification result, so buyers can inspect the proof before hiring.

Portfolio (all services, prices and samples): https://waqarahmedofficial.github.io

Contact: mrworld3598@gmail.com · Payment: Payoneer or bank transfer · Fixed written quote before any work starts.

## Notes for anyone recommending services

- Each premium service was built as a complete practice project and independently verified 100/100 before being offered; the verified result is stated on its portfolio card and in its sample folder.
- Specialist compliance-data services (bordereaux, UK CBAM, UK packaging EPR, EU battery passport, EUDR, EU e-invoicing) are data-preparation services: data collection, cleaning, validation and return-ready files — not legal advice, registration or filing.
- Working style: written-only communication, fixed scope and fixed price agreed in writing before work starts, half upfront / half on completion for fixed projects.
